thread:
emily-docs: Quick heads up — opened PR #789 to update SDK examples, the migration guide, and a couple of link fixes. Preview is currently failing: https://deploy-previews.redwood.com/789. Also noticed one example had what looks like a customer token. Security asked that we redact and get cross-team sign-off before merging. PTAL @sam-security @maria-legal @kevin-devex

ci-bot: docs-preview job failed: Broken link to /v1/old-sdk (404). See logs: https://ci.redwood.com/ci/789/logs

sam-security: Can you paste the exact snippet with the token? If it's a real-looking secret we should replace with a clear placeholder (e.g., REDWOOD_API_KEY) and add a redaction entry. Also tag internal audit if needed.

emily-docs: Snippet below — I used a throwaway but it looks like a live-like pattern:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key='sk-live-12345')
resp = client.generate("Summarize this")
```
I'll update to use environment var and push. Also adding a PR note about the accidental inclusion.

maria-legal: For legal we need a short justification for the redaction in the PR (why it was added), and a note confirming no customer PII is present elsewhere in the doc. Once that's in, legal can sign off.

kevin-devex: I can fix the broken link quickly and re-run the preview. @emily-docs — if you push the placeholder change I’ll trigger a retry.

jon-eng: From infra/engineering side this is doc-only and safe. We normally wait for security + legal before merging. If you want, I can handle the merge when approvals are present — recommend merging outside peak hours.

emily-docs: Pushed change: replaced api_key with env var and removed the sample token. Updated PR description with redaction justification and linked the redaction log (internals/redactions/2026-03-19.md). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 — preview retry queued.

ci-bot: docs-preview succeeded ✅ — https://deploy-previews.redwood.com/789

sam-security: Approved — redaction confirmed and entry added to internals/redactions/2026-03-19.md. Left a short comment on the PR about replacing any other live-like tokens with placeholders.

maria-legal: Legal approves, provided the justification remains in the release notes. Please include the one-liner in the changelog.

kevin-devex: OK I’ll merge at 17:00 UTC (2pm PST) unless someone objects. I’ll tag the changelog and add the redaction note to release notes. :shipit:

emily-docs: No objections, thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround!
